Gold loan kaise kaam karta hai?

Poora process seedha-saadha hai — pehla kadam aap abhi, isi page se utha sakte hain।

1

Online form bhariye

Apni detail, 2 reference number, bank detail aur gold ki jaankari step-by-step form mein bhariye।

2

Documents upload kariye

PAN card, Aadhaar (aage-peeche), bank passbook ka pehla page, apni photo aur gold ki photo — sab form mein hi upload ho jayega।

3

Application ki pushti

Submit karte hi aapki application documents ke saath hum tak pahunch jati hai। Aapko screen par ek receipt milti hai aur aapke email par confirmation bhi aata hai। Phir humari team call karke aage ki baat karegi।

4

Gold jaanch aur loan

Gold ki purity aur wazan ki jaanch ke baad loan ki rakkam tai hoti hai। Loan poora chukane par aapka sona aapko wapas mil jata hai।

Gold ki purity samjhein

Loan ki rakkam gold ke wazan ke saath-saath uski purity (carat) par bhi nirbhar karti hai। Form mein apne gold ki sahi purity chunein।

24 Carat

Sabse shudh sona

Lagbhag 99.9% shudh sona। Aam taur par sikke (coin) aur biscuit (bar) isi purity ke hote hain।

22 Carat

Zevaron wala sona

Lagbhag 91.6% shudh sona। Bharat mein zyadatar sone ke zevar 22 carat ke hi bante hain — form mein aksar yahi chuna jata hai।

18 Carat

Heere/moti wale zevar

75% shudh sona। Heere ya nag jadey zevar aam taur par 18 carat mein bante hain taaki jadai mazboot rahe।

Kyun Annapurna Finance?

Dukaan ka stock ho, bachon ki fees ho, ilaaj ho ya koi bhi zaroori kharcha — zaroorat ke samay ghar ka sona sabse aasan sahara banta hai। Hum koshish karte hain ki process aapke liye jitna ho sake utna seedha rahe।

  • Ghar baithe shuruaat। Poora form online — detail aur documents pehle hi email par pahunch jate hain, taaki aage ki baat-cheet tez ho।
  • Shartein pehle, faisla baad mein। Byaaj, kist aur avadhi loan final hone se pehle saaf bata di jati hai — loan lena ya na lena, antim faisla aapka।
  • Sona wapas, poora। Gold loan ka matlab hai — loan ki avadhi tak sona suraksha ke roop mein rehta hai, aur poora loan chukane par aapka sona aapko wapas mil jata hai।

              Aksar puche jaane wale sawaal

              Submit karne ke baad kya hoga?

              Submit karte hi aapko screen par ek receipt milegi jisme aapka application/reference number hoga, aur aapke email par confirmation bhi jayega। Humari team 48 ghante ke andar aapse sampark karne ki koshish karegi — isiliye apna mobile number sahi bhariye।

              Loan ki rakkam kitni milegi?

              Rakkam aapke gold ke wazan, purity (carat) aur jaanch ke baad tai hoti hai। Form mein apni zaroorat ki rakkam likh dein — final rakkam jaanch ke baad, loan final hone se pehle, aapko saaf bata di jayegi। Koi pakki rakkam ya approval ka vada hum pehle se nahi karte।

              Byaaj dar (interest) kitna lagega?

              Byaaj dar rakkam aur avadhi ke hisaab se tai hoti hai। Upar diye EMI calculator se aap alag-alag dar par kist ka anumaan laga sakte hain। Final dar loan lene se pehle sharton mein saaf likh kar di jayegi।

              Kya mera sona surakshit rahega? Wapas milega na?

              Gold loan mein sona loan ki suraksha ke roop mein rakha jata hai। Poora loan (byaaj sahit) chukane par aapka sona aapko wapas mil jata hai — yahi gold loan ka aam tareeka hai। Apne case ki poori shartein loan final hone se pehle samajh lein।

              Reference number kyun manga jata hai?

              Reference woh do log hain jinhe aap jaante hain — parivaar, dost ya koi anya। Zaroorat padne par (jaise aapka phone band mile) hum unse sampark karke aap tak sandesh pahuncha sakte hain। Un par loan ki koi zimmedari nahi hoti।

              Documents ki photo kaisi honi chahiye?

              Photo saaf aur padhne layak ho — dhundli, kati hui ya andhere mein li photo se jaanch mein deri hoti hai। Aadhaar ki dono taraf (aage-peeche) ki alag photo dein, kyunki peeche ki taraf aapka pata chhapa hota hai।
